source_access: Selected PDF pages 1,3,5,6,7,8,16,17 visually inspected, including Figure 5. No full numerical reproduction or field digitization.

measurements.name: Antarctic Circumpolar Current
measurements.range_interpretation: Approximate local climatological major-front separation; no uncertainty interval, seasonal range or pooled 170-500 km interval.
measurements.geographic_scope: Udintsev Fracture Zone entrance at 144 degrees W; local meridional contour separation.
measurements.section_orientation: Meridional distance between source-defined MDT contours; not a recovered flow-normal transect.
measurements.layer: Surface geostrophic climatological MDT contour support; no fixed-depth width slab. Hydrographic and bottom-referenced transport layers are separate.
measurements.time_convention: CNES-CLS18 MDT reference period 1993-2012. Assimilated observations 1993-2016, Argo validation 2001-2017, and cruises February 2016/December 2017 are separate supports; no dated width occupation or monthly widths.
measurements.boundary_rule: Source-defined SAF to SACCF meridional separation at 144 degrees W, MDT contours [-0.1, -1.0] m; no adopted velocity cutoff.
measurements.source_citation: Park, Y.-H. et al. (2019), Observations of the Antarctic Circumpolar Current Over the Udintsev Fracture Zone, the Narrowest Choke Point in the Southern Ocean, JGR Oceans 124, 4511-4528, doi:10.1029/2019JC015024.
measurements.source_locator: PDF p7 / printed 4517; definitions pp3,5-6 / printed 4513,4515-4516; Figure 5 p8 / printed 4518.
measurements.extraction_method: Approximate quantity transcribed from original p4517; selected methods and Figure 5 visually reviewed. No contour-coordinate extraction or recomputation.
measurements.source_quality_note: Original regional MDT method reviewed. Two different contour-defined quantities remain distinct; exact paired coordinates and numerical uncertainty unresolved.
remaining_gates: Recover exact matched contour coordinates and reproduce the meridional separation with product provenance.
Establish dated contour/velocity definitions before monthly or seasonal widths.
Independent scientific admission; no whole-current ranking, route buffer or physical state intersection.

original_regional_context.display_caption: Approximately 170 km · Major-front separation (SAF–SACCF) at Udintsev, 144°W. Separate from the 500 km quantity; no pooled 170–500 km interval. Numerical uncertainty unknown.

No seasonal width playback.
